howItWorks.title: How do you find a professional with Matchy+?

steps.title: 1. Create your account
steps.text: Sign up or log in to your Matchy+ space.

steps.title: 2. Describe your needs
steps.text: Enter your goals, preferences and location.

steps.title: 3. Receive recommendations
steps.text: Intelligent matching and geolocation suggest relevant profiles.

steps.title: 4. Connect directly
steps.text: Review the suggested profiles and contact the person you choose.

professionalCta.title: Offer a service? Make your activity more visible
professionalCta.text: Create a professional profile, showcase your skills, define your service area and be discovered by people looking for your services.

clarity.title: Choose with greater clarity
clarity.text: Matchy+ supports discovery and initial contact. Before any service, review the profile, clarify your needs, request useful documents and agree on price, timeframe and conditions.

cities.title: Explore services by city
cities.text: Availability depends on registered professionals and their service areas. Start with cities where profiles are genuinely available.

items.question: How do I find a professional near me?
items.answer: Choose the service you need and enter your city. Matchy+ displays available profiles based on your needs and location.

items.question: Can I contact a professional directly?
items.answer: Yes. Depending on the profile’s enabled preferences, you may use messaging, WhatsApp or phone.

items.question: Does Matchy+ set service prices?
items.answer: No. The customer and professional agree directly on price, timeframe, payment method and service conditions.

items.question: Can I offer several services?
items.answer: Yes, within the limit of your profile or plan. Add only services you can genuinely provide.

items.question: Are all professionals verified?
items.answer: The presence of a profile does not mean every declared skill or qualification has been verified. Request useful information and documents before any service.

finalCta.title: The right professional may be closer than you think
finalCta.text: Search for a local service or create your profile to showcase your skills to new customers.
